analysis: San Francisco is missing six contributors for this one -- starting WR Jauan Jennings and starting tackle Jaylon Moore (both concussion), LB Dre Greenlaw (1-game suspension), DT Arik Armstead, S Ji'Ayir Brown, and TE Ross Dwelley -- while Washington's only real question is Terry McLaurin (hamstring, DNP Friday, no confirmed Monday status yet). The sim's adjusted total fell from 47.3 to 42.0 against a 52 market total, with the Niners still comfortably favored (74% win, -7.5ish margin) even with the injury list.

The gap here is almost entirely about total scoring, not the spread -- SF's offensive injuries (Jennings, Moore) are the kind that slow a scoring pace without necessarily costing the game outright against a banged-up Washington roster of its own. McLaurin's status is genuinely unresolved into Monday, so treat the Commanders' offensive projection as having some unpriced downside risk if he sits.
